cli.callbackAccepted: Authentication response received. Return to the terminal.
cli.delivery.unresolved: Change unconfirmed. Retry the exact request with {retryCommand}, or check it with {statusCommand}. The check becomes final when the operation lifetime ends.
cli.failure.CONTRACT_MISMATCH: The client and service contracts do not match.
cli.failure.INSTALLATION_MISMATCH: Not sent: this request belongs to another installation. Resolve it against its original installation; prepare a fresh request for this installation.
cli.failure.RECOVERY_UNAVAILABLE: Not sent: the local record of unconfirmed changes cannot be saved. Check free space and permissions for the configured recovery state directory, then try again.
cli.family.configure: Save public connection settings or show their sources.
cli.family.session: Process structured requests in one session.
cli.family.shell: Run interactive commands with one sign-in.
cli.help.call:
`call` reads one JSON request from stdin; `session` reads one request per line.
If a change request has no operation ID, the CLI creates one and prints it.
See docs/integrating.md#cli-use for the exact request format and limits.
cli.help.configuration:
Settings are saved in ~/.config/claimcore/profile.json. Environment variables override them.
Secrets are never saved; supply them through a file.
Run `claimcore configure --show` to see effective values and their sources.
See docs/integrating.md#cli-use.
cli.help.configure:
Save public connection and language settings in the profile.
Run `claimcore configure --show` to inspect effective values and their sources.
Supply secrets through files; they are never saved in the profile.
See docs/integrating.md#cli-use.
cli.help.delivery:
If delivery is unconfirmed, exit code 4 prints the exact request to send again.
Sending it again cannot record it twice.
Use `claimcore recovery list` and `claimcore recovery check` to see the answer; it becomes final within {window}.
cli.help.examples: Prepare requests offline, inspect schemas, then send an admitted frame.
cli.help.help: Explore command families or select a topic. Use --format json for structured help, or help exit-codes for process results.
cli.help.layout:
ClaimCore structured HTTPS client. Help and discovery work offline; call and session require authentication.
{body}
cli.help.liveTraversal:
Each list page uses the access and case details available when it is read.
Concurrent changes can move, repeat or omit rows.
Using --all reads every page; it does not freeze the results.
cli.help.recovery:
List unconfirmed changes with `recovery list`.
Check one with `recovery check ATTEMPT_ID`; interactive checks wait for a final answer.
Use --format json for machine output.
Restart recovery checks earlier changes without resending them.
cli.help.schema: Inspect the request and response schemas. Schema output is JSON.
cli.help.shell:
Run commands interactively; use `exit` or EOF to leave.
Sign-in tokens and command history stay in memory until you leave.
Ctrl-C cancels the current command.
See docs/integrating.md#cli-use for quoting and recovery rules.
cli.shell.invalidLine: Unterminated quote or trailing backslash. The command was not run.
cli.text.authorityHistoryEmpty: No authority changes match this selection.
cli.text.editorCleanupUnavailable: Private editor text cleanup failed. No request was prepared. Review your local temporary files before retrying.
cli.text.recoveryCleanupUnavailable: The outcome is known, but this local attempt could not be cleared. Its identity has been kept; you can check status again.
cli.text.recoveryEmpty: No unconfirmed changes for this account and installation.
cli.text.uncertain: Outcome unresolved. Keep the exact retry frame printed on stderr; retrying the identical request is safe.
cli.usage.configureOptions: Configure accepts --show alone or the documented public settings. Secret options are refused.
cli.usage.helpOptions: Use help [topic | family [verb]] with --format text|json and an optional --language.
cli.usage.invocation: Invalid invocation of {command}. This command accepts no options or operands.
cli.usage.requestTooLarge: The prepared request must not exceed {maximumBytes} UTF-8 bytes.
cli.usage.schemaOptions: Schema accepts a name or an endpoint and direction, without options.
cli.usage.schemaSelector: Unknown schema selection. Use a schema name or an endpoint followed by request or response.
cli.next.correctInput: Correct the reported inputs and try again.
cli.next.readCurrent: Read the current record and review it before trying again.
cli.next.investigate: Stop and ask an administrator to investigate.
cli.next.askAccess: Ask an owner to check your access.
cli.next.askRoles: Ask an owner for the {roles} role.
cli.next.reviewLatest: Read the latest record and review the changes before trying again.
cli.text.operationPending: Waiting for a final answer until {finalAt}.
